what: a heavy closed portcullis seen exactly face-on: one square grid of thick bronze bars, five upright bars crossed by four horizontal bars, each bar as thick as a man's wrist, a big round rivet where every two bars cross, and every upright bar ending at the bottom in a short sharp spike. Between the bars there is only empty backdrop. The old bronze has gone dull green with verdigris, with warm brown-gold bronze showing on the worn edges.
colours: dull verdigris green bronze, warm brown-gold bronze on the worn edges, dark brown in the shadows.
pose: Seen exactly from the front, flat and upright like a playing card, a square grid, nothing behind it.
must_show: square grid of thick bronze bars

what: a packed crowd of three life-size stone statues of people standing shoulder to shoulder, carved together as one mass of grey stone, the whole group wholly inside the picture with backdrop all round it: a man in front at the middle with his arm thrown up before his face, and behind him a woman at the left and a bearded man at the right, overlapping so that no backdrop shows between them. They wear Greek tunics and cloaks. Every part of every figure, faces, hair, beards, tunics, cloaks and arms, is the same weathered grey stone with blank stone eyes, cracked, with small patches of dark green moss on their heads and shoulders. Realistic adult proportions, about eight heads tall, shown full length from their heads to their feet.
colours: cool weathered mid-grey stone all over like an old church statue, darker grey in the cracks, small patches of dark green moss.
pose: All three stand frozen in fear, crowded together, bodies turned slightly to one side, as if they had all looked at the same thing at once.
action: They are stone, still and lifeless, caught in one frozen moment of terror, packed close together like a crowd in a doorway.
must_show: grey stone in every part including faces

what: one wide flat sheet of roaring fire shaped like a rectangle, wider than it is tall, wholly inside the picture with backdrop all round it: a solid wall of flame of the same height all the way across, its flat bottom edge straight, its top edge a ragged row of many leaping tongues of flame all of about the same height, yellow-white at the heart and low down, deep orange at the edges and tips, with darker red-orange folds between the tongues.
